title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
BTC ETF $137M inflow (Aug 17) — first notable positive day after weeks of net outflows.
DXY below 100 at 2-month low (99.4); weak US data trims Sept hike odds further.
Brent $91/bbl, highest since July — Kushner: Iran shows "no interest in a deal".
FOMC July minutes drop tomorrow (Aug 19 14:00 ET); 9-3 hold vote, 3 dissenters favoured hike.
